title: US: wealth falls behind years before dementia sets in
unit: US$1,000s of net worth vs similar households

metadata.source: NBER WP 34659 (Li, McGarry, Nicholas, Skinner 2026), Table A1, net worth column. US Health & Retirement Study, 2018 USD.
metadata.note: Event-study marginal effect on household net worth relative to 6 years before dementia onset, vs propensity-matched controls. The gap opens about 6 years before onset and widens to roughly $125,000 below similar households four years after. US evidence — shown to illustrate the mechanism, not as an India figure. Onset here is the study's research measure (cognitive score crossing a threshold), not a clinical diagnosis; most cases were never formally diagnosed.
